new_content.name: Basic Magnet
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shaped: iron ingots around an ender pearl, with lapis lazuli and redstone dust in two corners (grid in editor_notes).
new_content.notes: Picks up items and experience within 5 blocks while active. Right-click while holding it to toggle on/off.

new_content.name: Advanced Magnet
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shaped: Basic Magnet, eye of ender, diamond, gold ingots, lapis lazuli and redstone dust (grid in editor_notes).
new_content.notes: Range up to 11 blocks; item and experience range configured separately; whitelist/blacklist filter. Shift+right-click while holding it opens its GUI.

new_content.name: Basic Demagnetization Coil
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shaped: 4 iron ingots, 2 redstone dust, 1 gold ingot (grid in editor_notes).
new_content.notes: Placed block that prevents items within up to 3 blocks from being attracted by magnets. Right-click it with an empty hand to open its GUI.

new_content.name: Advanced Demagnetization Coil
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shaped: Basic Demagnetization Coil, glowstone dust, 2 redstone dust and 4 gold ingots (grid in editor_notes).
new_content.notes: Range up to 5 blocks, with an item filter.

mechanics.title: Toggling and filters
mechanics.description: Magnets are toggled by right-clicking with the magnet selected in the hotbar, or with a key bind. The Advanced Magnet GUI has filter slots, a whitelist/blacklist switch and a match-NBT option. Magnets can also be worn in Trinkets-style slots (the jar ships Trinkets slot tags).

mechanics.title: Demagnetization coils
mechanics.description: Items inside a coil's area are ignored by magnets, useful for keeping item-sorting or farm collection areas from being drained by a player carrying a magnet.

qol: Automatically collects drops and experience while active.
commands_and_keybinds: Right-click with a magnet: toggle on/off
Shift+right-click with Advanced Magnet: open GUI
Right-click a coil with an empty hand: open its GUI
A key bind to toggle the magnet exists (check Options > Controls for the default)
getting_started: Craft a Basic Magnet, hold it and right-click to turn it on. Upgrade to the Advanced Magnet for filtering and more range.
editor_notes: Exact recipes from recipe facts. Basic Magnet = AAB/AC_/AAD: A=iron ingot, B=lapis, C=ender pearl, D=redstone dust. Advanced Magnet = AAB/CDE/AAF: A=gold ingot, B=lapis, C=Basic Magnet, D=eye of ender, E=diamond, F=redstone dust. Basic Demag Coil = _A_/BCB/CCC: A=gold ingot, B=redstone dust, C=iron ingot. Advanced Demag Coil = _A_/BCB/CDC: A=glowstone dust, B=redstone dust, C=gold ingot, D=Basic Demagnetization Coil. Tag inputs (#c:ingots/iron etc.) accept equivalents from other mods. Basic range 5, Advanced max 11 per Modrinth; Basic coil 3, Advanced coil 5.
name: Simple Magnets
summary: Adds handheld magnets that pull dropped items and experience orbs toward the player, plus demagnetization coils that stop items from being attracted in a small area. The Basic Magnet has a fixed range; the Advanced Magnet has configurable range and item filters.
